title: tracking message
description: Tracked objects: a box, a caption with the track's id and a trail of its centers, in the id's color. Version 1 of the contract in docs/contracts.md.

tracks.description: Every track seen on the frame. An empty list clears the boxes of the frame before.

id.description: The track's identity, stable while it lives. It picks the color and keeps the trail; a track without one gets neither.

label.description: Shown in the caption, 'track' when absent. The color follows the id, not the label.

confidence.description: Compared with the viewer's confidence threshold; a track without one always passes.
